Lease to Rent Dry Van: $900/Week Truck, USPS Mail Loads

A simple setup: $900 a week for the truck, a 22% per-load fee that covers trailer, insurance and ELD, plus USPS mail loads for extra miles.

Apply for this job 2 minutes · No resume needed

Truck rent$900/week

Pay

  • Weekly pay: statement Friday, payday Tuesday

Costs to know

  • Driver deposit $2,500 ($250/week over 10 weeks)

Truck

  • ELD, fridge, microwave, A/C
  • Pet friendly, companion may ride along
  • Tools and scales are the driver's responsibility
